contacts.note: The governed exact-ID reference loader also verifies selected audio metadata and hashes audio bytes; that is file validation, not speech decoding or model observation.

hypothesis: Date/time surface and presence errors may reveal missing task-specific boundaries despite already available generic slot rules; no acoustic cause is assumed.
limits: Descriptive post-result diagnosis, not a fresh effectiveness claim.
Do not infer acoustic cause from filler disagreement.
Any later knowledge content must be constructed from admitted sources excluding evaluation A/B; this audit can identify questions but cannot donate answer strings or sample-specific hints.
No new GPU flight, mechanism, scorer invocation or contact is admitted.

projection.interpretation: No changed score, candidate answer, delivery rule or normalization is generated.
projection.matching: Use the shared separate official word and character greedy match blocks. Report agreement of the selected gold partner and do not silently combine different partners.
projection.official_reconciliation: Reuse attribute_parsed_rows to reconcile all six saved per-sample official SLU ingredients before any new aggregate. Verify parser flags and exact entity counts as available.
projection.persistence: Save source hashes/sample IDs and categorical/numeric records only. No reference or predicted sentence/filler strings in Git or the derivative JSON. Raw strings can appear solely in the offline analyst tool display and must never be fed to an experiment model or reused as knowledge exemplars.
projection.reference_sentence_support: For each unmatched prediction, record whether its alphanumeric token sequence occurs contiguously in the reference sentence. This is offline textual agreement, not proof of what the model heard, causal hallucination or runtime-accessible evidence.
surface_order: gold token sequence contained contiguously in predicted token sequence
predicted token sequence contained contiguously in gold token sequence
projection.token_rule: Use re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", value.casefold()) as a local string diagnostic, never a model tokenizer. Empty sequences cannot establish containment.

selection.case_read: Root may inspect temporal fillers and associated reference sentences from this released complete source offline to explain categorical errors. This is a diagnostic case audit, not a new effectiveness screen.
selection.population: Exactly all 1080 released TRAIN Fold A anchor IDs, with all malformed outputs retained. No new roster, Fold B, aborted flight or live A1 result is read.
selection.quantitative_denominator: Full1080, all18 scenarios, and the already defined intent-correct and intent-wrong cohorts. Report gold/predicted presence and support counts.
selection.why: The completed September 14 full-cohort audit ranks date and time first and second in attributed loss. This follow-up is exploratory and informed by that released diagnostic.
